metal.rationale: Direct match - cans, foil, metal scrap.

biological.rationale: Food/yard scraps are the definition of organic waste.

green-glass.rationale: Colour variant of glass; material identical for recycling.

clothes.rationale: Fabric garments form the textile recycling stream.

shoes.rationale: FLAGGED: footwear is not strictly fabric, but municipal textile streams and RealWaste 'Textile Trash' both cover worn footwear; kept together deliberately.

battery.rationale: Household batteries; operationally routed to HAZARDOUS stream.

trash.rationale: Dataset explicitly defines 'trash' as residual/mixed waste.

Textile Trash.rationale: Fabric/textile trash; validates shoes->textile choice above.

Vegetation.rationale: Garden/yard waste. Kept SEPARATE from food organics: visually distinct (leaves/branches vs food), and RealWaste treats it as its own class. Operationally merged into organic_waste downstream (FLAGGED).

notes: shoes->textile and Vegetation->organic_waste are FLAGGED judgement calls, documented above.
Exact duplicates removed before clustering; near-dup clusters never span splits.
